headline: Viktoria House / Architekt Andreas Gruber
context: Viktoria's House is a concrete residence located in Vals, South Tyrol, at an elevation of approximately 1,350 meters above sea level. The house is set against steeply rising mountain slopes that transition from meadows and forests to rugged alpine peaks.
